arenaStashSaleEstimates.method: Median observed GP access price times an explicit item-category factor; Ref multipliers 1/1.1/1.25/1.5. Selling versus unlocking are different markets; this is a conservative mod economy seed, not a live conversion formula.

seedBasis.rationale: Keep individual utilities below major medical/weapon costs; armor scales nonlinearly; mods consume hundreds to low thousands per build. Grenade relative ordering follows the shop but conversion scale is a mod choice.
